SERVICE_CONTEXT.service_summary: You are welcome. I was a high school and college counselor for a very long time. QuestBridge is one of the best programs out there. Take advantage of everything they have to offer. Do the same with all the service available to you as a student. This isn't a journey you want to take alone. Good luck and have fun!
